name: Dual Contouring on Octree
aliases: Dual Contouring: Seams & LOD for Chunked Terrain
definition: A recursive octree traversal and contouring algorithm that extracts a mesh by processing leaf nodes, cell faces, and cell edges to generate vertices and triangle indices.
summary: Dual Contouring on Octree extracts triangle meshes from scalar fields using an adaptive octree and QEF minimization, differing by recursively stitching vertices across subdivision levels for topological consistency.
